### 5.4 Entry/Exit/Suspension/Resumption Criteria

#### Entry Criteria
- Code deployed to test environment
- Test environment matches production configuration
- Test data available
- Smoke tests pass

#### Exit Criteria
- All test items executed
- Critical/High defects resolved
- Test coverage >= 90% of acceptance criteria
- No blocking defects remain

#### Suspension Criteria
- Critical defect blocking further testing
- Test environment unavailable
- Requirements changed significantly

#### Resumption Criteria
- Blocking defect resolved and verified
- Test environment restored
- Updated requirements reviewed

## 6. Pass/Fail Criteria

### 6.1 Item Pass Criteria
A test item passes when all its test cases execute successfully and the actual behavior matches expected behavior per acceptance criteria.

### 6.2 Plan Pass Criteria
Test plan passes when: 1) All Critical/High risk test items pass, 2) No Critical/High severity defects open, 3) >= 90% of Medium risk test items pass, 4) All acceptance criteria verified

## 7. Suspension/Resumption Criteria

Testing may be suspended if a Critical severity defect blocks further test execution, the test environment becomes unavailable, or requirements change significantly. Testing resumes when the blocking issue is resolved, environment is restored, or updated requirements are reviewed and test plan is updated accordingly.

## 14. Risks and Contingencies

| Risk | Probability | Impact | Mitigation | Contingency |
|------|-------------|--------|------------|-------------|
| High priority ticket (High) - limited time for thorough testing | Medium | High | Prioritize Critical/High risk test items; automate regression where possible | Extend test execution timeline; reduce scope of Low risk items |
| Test environment instability or unavailability | Medium | High | Environment health checks before execution; backup environment identified | Escalate to DevOps; use local/staging environment as fallback |
| Incomplete or ambiguous acceptance criteria | Medium | Medium | Clarify AC with Product Owner during test plan review | Document assumptions; test based on best understanding |
| Late defect fixes reducing retest time | High | Medium | Early defect reporting; prioritize Critical/High defects | Risk-based retesting; focus on fixed areas only |
| Scope creep during testing | Low | Medium | Strict change control; new requirements go to next sprint | Assess impact; update test plan if approved |
| Component 'Backend' complexity may hide integration issues | Medium | Medium | Include integration test cases; coordinate with component owners | Additional integration testing session |
| Component 'Security' complexity may hide integration issues | Medium | Medium | Include integration test cases; coordinate with component owners | Additional integration testing session |
